datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 25.1 thousand buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 91% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 2 years ( Last edited 2 months ago ) and 31% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics OpenStreetMap exports for use in GIS applications. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and validated against AI-mapped estimates, covering approximately 91% of total buildings in Guam. Data were exported in multiple GIS formats (Shapefile, GeoPackage, GeoJSON, KML) with metadata on data currency and completeness.
